summary: KT Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a conference call and webcast for its Q1 2026 earnings release on May 12, 2026. The filing serves as a routine earnings announcement notice and does not disclose any special-situation transaction. There are no terms, recommendations, or structural details related to acquisitions, divestitures, activism, strategic reviews, or other corporate events. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16.
